key_facts: PhD C explains that combo is a system where features go through a network, then a low-pass filtered version of the same features goes through another MLP, and the linear outputs of these two MLPs are combined by adding the values.
The weighting scheme used for evaluation is forty percent for TI-digit, sixty percent for all the SpeechDat-Cars, with well match at forty, medium thirty-five, and high mismatch twenty-five.
The results for the highly mismatched Italian are significantly worse when the KLT size is reduced.
The test sets are between five hundred and two thousand sentences, with each sentence containing between one and sixteen digits.
The system is planned to be fixed on Tuesday, with the results to be written up soon.
There is an offer of processing power from Jeff at the University of Washington, with ten IBM RS 6000 machines, each with four processors.
The digits recording is starting to form a good size collection, which will be used alongside the SpeechDat data for further work.
